name: Factorial zeros
title: F. Factorial zeros
legend: You are given a positive integer n. Output the number of trailing zeros in n! (n! denotes a product of integers between 1 and n, inclusive).
input_spec: The only line of input contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000000).
output_spec: Output the number of trailing zeros in n!.
note:
In the first sample 6! = 720.

In the second sample 24! = 620448401733239439360000.
